description: This file defines the ExtensionsManager class responsible for managing extensions in the Superset frontend, including loading remote modules, activating/deactivating extensions, and retrieving contributions like menus, views, commands, and editors.

classes.name: ExtensionsManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle and contributions of extensions in the application.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ExtensionsManager.

methods.name: initializeExtensions
methods.description: Fetches and initializes all extensions from the API.

methods.name: initializeExtension
methods.description: Initializes a specific extension, loading remote modules if necessary.

methods.name: enableExtension
methods.description: Enables an extension by activating it and indexing its contributions.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Dynamically loads a remote extension module via script injection and Webpack module federation.

methods.name: activateExtension
methods.description: Activates an extension by calling its activate method with a context.

methods.name: deactivateExtension
methods.description: Deactivates an extension, disposing of resources and calling its deactivate method.

methods.name: indexContributions
methods.description: Stores an extension's contributions for quick retrieval.

methods.name: getMenuContributions
methods.description: Retrieves merged menu contributions for a given key.

methods.name: getViewContributions
methods.description: Retrieves view contributions for a given key.

methods.name: getCommandContributions
methods.description: Returns all command contributions from all extensions.

methods.name: getCommandContribution
methods.description: Finds a command contribution by its key.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension by id.

methods.name: getEditorContributions
methods.description: Returns all editor contributions from extensions.
